items.exampleEn: Chess is hard to learn, but it is fun.
items.exampleZh: 西洋棋很難學，但很好玩。

items.exampleEn: Everyone wanted a photo with the superstar.
items.exampleZh: 大家都想跟那位超級巨星合照。

items.exampleEn: Camping is cheaper than staying in a hotel.

items.exampleZh: 貝多芬寫了九首交響曲。

items.exampleEn: You can't play a cassette on a phone.
My parents met at a disco when they were young.
items.exampleZh: 我爸媽年輕時在迪斯可舞廳認識。

items.exampleEn: Hiking in the mountains is my favorite weekend activity.
items.exampleZh: 去山上健行是我最喜歡的週末活動。

items.sentenceEn: Let's play a game of chess.
items.sentenceZh: 我們來下一盤西洋棋吧。

items.audioEn: We're going camping this weekend, so please bring a warm jacket.
items.audioZh: 我們這個週末要去露營，請帶一件保暖的外套。
items.questionZh: 為什麼要帶保暖的外套？
options: Because the bus will be very cold

items.sentenceEn: That singer is a real superstar in Asia.
items.sentenceZh: 那位歌手在亞洲是真正的超級巨星。

items.sentenceEn: Do you still have a cassette player?
items.sentenceZh: 你還有錄音帶播放機嗎？

items.stemEn: Every Sunday, my grandpa plays ____ with his friends in the park.
items.stemZh: 每個星期天，我爺爺都和朋友在公園下西洋棋。

items.stemEn: We slept in the forest when we went ____.
items.stemZh: 我們去露營時睡在森林裡。

items.passageEn: My father is fifty, and he still loves the music of his youth. He keeps hundreds of old cassettes, and on Saturday nights he dances like he is at a disco. But my mother likes classical music. Last month, they went to hear a symphony together. My father fell asleep!
items.passageZh: 我爸爸五十歲了，還是很愛他年輕時的音樂。他收藏了好幾百捲舊錄音帶，星期六晚上還會像在迪斯可舞廳一樣跳舞。可是我媽媽喜歡古典音樂。上個月，他們一起去聽交響曲，結果我爸爸睡著了！

questions.questionZh: 爸爸星期六晚上會做什麼？
options: 和老朋友在公園裡下西洋棋
像在迪斯可舞廳一樣跳舞

questions.questionZh: 他們去聽交響曲時發生了什麼事？

referenceEn: She is a superstar in Korea.
She is a big superstar in Korea.

items.instructionZh: 用 hiking 造一個句子，說說你去健行的經驗或計畫。
referenceEn: I go hiking with my friends once a month.
We saw a lot of birds when we went hiking.
rubricZh: hiking 當名詞表示「健行」（例如 go hiking、Hiking is…）
時態配合句意（例如 go、saw）
